items.title: Hackers Exploit Citrix NetScaler 0-Days to Deploy Platypus Remote Access Tool
items.description:
Threat actors are exploiting two critical Citrix NetScaler zero-day vulnerabilities to deploy a modified Platypus remote access tool on exposed ADC and Gateway appliances. The activity shows how quickly attackers are moving from initial access to persistent control of edge devices that often sit between corporate networks and the public internet. items.kql_query:
// SENTINEL APEX — CVE-2026-107423 — Anomalous Activity Detection
// Product: Web Application | Generated: 2026-10-12T10:22:03Z
let lookback = 1d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where EventID in (4625, 4648, 4728, 4740, 4776)
| summarize FailureCount = count(), DistinctTargets = dcount(TargetUserName)
    by IpAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where FailureCount > 10 or DistinctTargets > 5
| extend Severity = "MEDIUM", CVE = "CVE-2026-107423", RuleSource = "SENTINEL-APEX"
| order by TimeGenerated desc
